docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: handler 执行及响应写出期限；direct 模式可能包含外部 I/O，因此默认较宽松。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Timeout for handler execution and response writing; direct mode may involve external I/O, so the default is more lenient.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: llm 模式后台 worker 数。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Number of background workers in LLM mode.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 建议先绑定本地地址，需要暴露时再用反代或内网转发。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: It is recommended to bind to a local address first, and use a reverse proxy or intranet forwarding when exposure is needed.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 单个 Atriena 请求 body 上限。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Request body limit for a single Atriena request.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 外部工具默认允许，此处只禁用指定工具。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: External tools are allowed by default; only specified tools are disabled here.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: llm 模式后台队列长度。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Background queue length for LLM mode.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: { platform = "telegram" }, # 禁用 telegram 整个平台所有投递。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: { platform = "telegram" }, # Disable all deliveries for the entire telegram platform.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 整个请求（含 body）读取期限。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Read timeout for the entire request (including body).

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 从系统环境变量或配置目录 .env 读取。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Read from system environment variables or the .env file in the configuration directory.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 默认允许 Atriwisp 预加载的 ATRI-X 内部工具。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: By default, ATRI-X internal tools preloaded by Atriwisp are allowed.
Overrides the top-level allowed_tools when present.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: Atriwisp 默认启用；只有需要限制 token、覆盖投递策略或禁用时才配置。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Atriwisp is enabled by default; configure it only when you need to limit tokens, override delivery policies, or disable it.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 只有显式 enabled=false 才禁用该 Atriwisp。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: This Atriwisp is disabled only when enabled=false is explicitly set.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.source: Atrinis 总开关；false 时不启动 HTTP runtime。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Atrinis master switch; if false, the HTTP runtime will not start.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:01e038a9a96a7.source: token 原文不写入配置，推荐放在系统环境变量或配置目录 __ATRIX_CODE_0__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:01e038a9a96a7.translation: Do not write the token plaintext into the configuration; it is recommended to place it in system environment variables or the configuration directory __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:06162ed371667.source: 需要接收 Atriena 事件时请使用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或 __ATRIX_CODE_1__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:06162ed371667.translation: Please use __ATRIX_CODE_0__ or __ATRIX_CODE_1__ when you need to receive Atriena events.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:18d7c946fe261.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是 CLI-only 模式，即使 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 也不会启动 Atrinis HTTP runtime；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:18d7c946fe261.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is CLI-only mode; even with __ATRIX_CODE_1__, the Atrinis HTTP runtime will not start;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:1cd550c5433ea.translation: The original token text is not written to logs.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:1e556fd35e358.source: HTTP 超时配置小于等于 0 时使用上述安全默认值，不能用 0 关闭超时。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:1e556fd35e358.translation: When HTTP timeout configurations are less than or equal to 0, the aforementioned safe default values are used; timeouts cannot be disabled by using 0.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:201013c9bde86.source: 文件大小受 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 的 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 限制（默认 100MB）。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:201013c9bde86.translation: File size is limited by __ATRIX_CODE_1__ of __ATRIX_CODE_0__ (default 100MB).

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:21653b7be14b6.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__：投递到所有已启用平台超级管理员，不能同时写 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 或 __ATRIX_CODE_2__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:21653b7be14b6.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: deliver to the superadmins of all enabled platforms; __ATRIX_CODE_1__ or __ATRIX_CODE_2__ cannot be written at the same time.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:2c6e314197913.source: workspace 普通工作文件继续由 sandbox 管理；报告附件在确定需要持久化投递时导入中心。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:2c6e314197913.translation: Ordinary workspace files continue to be managed by the sandbox; report attachments are imported into the center when persistent delivery is determined to be necessary.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:3ed2ee6f0aa6e.translation: Local protocols such as __ATRIX_CODE_0__ are prohibited.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4271d0606e500.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 中的工具名或 Skill 名都会经过 Atrinis __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 裁决。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4271d0606e500.translation: Tool names or Skill names in __ATRIX_CODE_0__ will all undergo Atrinis __ATRIX_CODE_1__ adjudication.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4a57bd5c30952.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 只允许 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 或 __ATRIX_CODE_2__，不影响模型槽位。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4a57bd5c30952.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ only allows __ATRIX_CODE_1__ or __ATRIX_CODE_2__, and does not affect model slots.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4d925a6409fa7.source: Atriwisp 默认启用；没写 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、写了但没写 __ATRIX_CODE_1__、或写了 __ATRIX_CODE_2__ 都会接收。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4d925a6409fa7.translation: Atriwisp is enabled by default; it will receive events if __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is not specified, if it is specified but __ATRIX_CODE_1__ is not, or if __ATRIX_CODE_2__ is specified.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4f900faf8d273.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ URI 仅支持 base64 编码，解码后同样受限。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:4f900faf8d273.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ URIs only support base64 encoding and are similarly restricted after decoding.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:50b261bcb4ea6.source: 只有显式 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 才会禁用对应 Atriwisp。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:50b261bcb4ea6.translation: Only explicit __ATRIX_CODE_0__ will disable the corresponding Atriwisp.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:569d6f4933146.source: 外部工具默认允许；单个 Atriwisp 可以用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 禁用指定外部工具。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:569d6f4933146.translation: External tools are allowed by default; an individual Atriwisp can use __ATRIX_CODE_0__ to disable specific external tools.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:5aa752857d96b.source: 非 loopback 地址应放在反向代理后，由代理负责 TLS、连接上限和请求速率限制；应用层超时不能代替这些边界。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:5aa752857d96b.translation: Non-loopback addresses should be placed behind a reverse proxy, with the proxy handling TLS, connection limits, and request rate limiting; application-layer timeouts cannot replace these boundaries.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:60681e52a2995.source: 外部工具调用由 Atrinis 对声明的 endpoint 发起 HTTP JSON POST；外部工具自身负责实际风险边界，Atrinis 侧按 low 风险处理。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:60681e52a2995.translation: External tool calls are initiated by Atrinis as HTTP JSON POST requests to the declared endpoint; the external tool itself is responsible for the actual risk boundary, and Atrinis handles it as low-risk.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:6bcdd32305a97.source: direct 有实际投递目标时，导入或复用 Media Center 媒体，不保留 Atrinis sandbox 下载副本。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:6bcdd32305a97.translation: When 'direct' has an actual delivery target, Media Center media is imported or reused, and no download copy is kept in the Atrinis sandbox.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:841c4faf6c423.source: record、拒绝、重复或仅排队的事件不下载来源媒体。排队任务已有的媒体 ID 会建立引用。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:841c4faf6c423.translation: Events that are recorded, rejected, duplicated, or only queued do not download source media. References will be established for existing media IDs of queued tasks.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:89e3b78058a61.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 可以写多个环境变量名，按顺序尝试。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:89e3b78058a61.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ can contain multiple environment variable names, which will be tried in order.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:941b47c124f28.source: direct 模式同样支持 image/file 输出，平台不支持时自动降级为文字描述。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:941b47c124f28.translation: Direct mode also supports image/file output; it automatically degrades to a text description if the platform does not support it.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:97fe78e825ecc.source: Atriwisp 不能绕过 Tool Runtime 和 Security Policy 调用 ATRI-X 内部工具；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:97fe78e825ecc.translation: Atriwisp cannot bypass Tool Runtime and Security Policy to call ATRI-X internal tools;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:9a52ca54fe0c5.source: 只有 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或单 Atriwisp __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 显式列出的目标会被禁止。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:9a52ca54fe0c5.translation: Only targets explicitly listed in __ATRIX_CODE_0__ or a single Atriwisp __ATRIX_CODE_1__ will be prohibited.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:a13f06a0f6ad9.source: 顶层 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 是 ATRI-X 内部工具默认白名单，单个 Atriwisp 的 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 存在时覆盖它。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:a13f06a0f6ad9.translation: The top-level __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is the default whitelist for ATRI-X internal tools; it is overridden when __ATRIX_CODE_1__ of an individual Atriwisp exists.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:a81726beb6809.source: 当前 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 只适用于 Atrinis 与 CLI 同处一个 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 前台进程，或 service 模式启用 CLI 远程服务端的场景；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:a81726beb6809.translation: Currently, __ATRIX_CODE_0__ only applies to scenarios where Atrinis and the CLI are in the same __ATRIX_CODE_1__ foreground process, or when the CLI remote server is enabled in service mode;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:a95a163cabdfa.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: deliver to a specified platform private chat.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:b23870a2c38af.source: 只写 __ATRIX_CODE_0__：投递到该平台超级管理员。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:b23870a2c38af.translation: Only write __ATRIX_CODE_0__: deliver to the superadmin of that platform.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:bf6db6e8c643c.source: LLM 输入在实际执行时物化为稳定媒体 ID，Session 保存 ID，请求发送前再解析。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:bf6db6e8c643c.translation: LLM input is materialized into a stable media ID during actual execution; the Session saves the ID, which is then resolved before the request is sent.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:c0aaa41908dd7.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 时不启动 Atrinis HTTP runtime。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:c0aaa41908dd7.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ will not start the Atrinis HTTP runtime.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:c600d1d2a30c6.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__: deliver to a specified platform group chat.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:cbd41ddc5f851.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 限制哪些 token 可以代表该 Atriwisp 投递事件；不写则允许任意已认证 token。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:cbd41ddc5f851.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ restricts which tokens can represent the Atriwisp to deliver events; if not specified, any authenticated token is allowed.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:cd5380cecd060.source: 单个 Atriwisp 可用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 禁用指定工具。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:cd5380cecd060.translation: A single Atriwisp can use __ATRIX_CODE_0__ to disable specific tools.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:d3ddd39ed6afd.source: token 名只用于日志和审计，不等同于 Atriwisp 身份。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:d3ddd39ed6afd.translation: The token name is used only for logs and audit logs, and is not equivalent to the Atriwisp identity.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:e13fc650e0ccc.source: Atriwisp 声明的外部 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 默认允许，并通过 ToolRun 以 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 形式注入为模型可调用函数名；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:e13fc650e0ccc.translation: External __ATRIX_CODE_0__ declared by Atriwisp are allowed by default and are injected as model-callable function names in the form of __ATRIX_CODE_1__ via ToolRun;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:e2c9dd0d5972d.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 只能选择 __ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__、__ATRIX_CODE_3__，不能指定任意内部模式名；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:e2c9dd0d5972d.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ can only choose __ATRIX_CODE_1__, __ATRIX_CODE_2__, or __ATRIX_CODE_3__, and cannot specify an arbitrary internal mode name;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:edeedbe6cdd74.source: 独立 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 进程需连接服务端后才能收到通知。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:edeedbe6cdd74.translation: Independent __ATRIX_CODE_0__ processes must connect to the server before they can receive notifications.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:f1d286751dd1e.source: 文件名已有扩展名（包括 __ATRIX_CODE_0__）时保留原名，仅无扩展名时补全。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:list:f1d286751dd1e.translation: The original name is preserved if the filename already has an extension (including __ATRIX_CODE_0__); it is only completed when no extension exists.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:042c6caa.source: 缓存过期释放关联引用；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:042c6caa.translation: Association references are released upon cache expiration;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:12cd807f.source: QQ OneBot、QQ Official、Telegram 支持在引用回复中恢复关联媒体；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:12cd807f.translation: QQ OneBot, QQ Official, and Telegram support restoring associated media in quoted replies;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:1ef8745b.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 会提供协议说明、配置片段、事件模板、代码脚手架和测试命令；真正写文件或运行命令仍会继续使用对应工具。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:1ef8745b.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ will provide protocol descriptions, configuration snippets, event templates, code scaffolding, and test commands; actually writing files or running commands will still continue to use the corresponding tools.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:1f02ccdb.source: 失败保留删除状态供重试。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:1f02ccdb.translation: Failures retain the deletion status for retries.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:214479bc.source: 达到宽限期后在下一次媒体维护任务执行时清理，并非一小时整立即删除。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:214479bc.translation: Once the grace period is reached, cleanup occurs during the next execution of the media maintenance task, rather than being deleted immediately at exactly one hour.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:24bcbbf6.source: 未知字段会被忽略，不参与协议语义、规范化、事件 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或审计；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:24bcbbf6.translation: Unknown fields will be ignored and will not participate in protocol semantics, normalization, event __ATRIX_CODE_0__, or auditing;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:24c7b2e6.source: Atrinis 默认关闭。启用时先在 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 中声明配置文件入口：
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:24c7b2e6.translation: Atrinis is disabled by default. When enabling it, first declare the configuration file entry in __ATRIX_CODE_0__:

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:26f09064.source: 如果同一个 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 再次发送，Atrinis 会返回 duplicate，不重复分发。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:26f09064.translation: If the same __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is sent again, Atrinis will return duplicate and will not redistribute it.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:429ab2ad.source: Atriwisp 可以在 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 中声明期望目标，但最终目标由 Atrinis 裁决。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:429ab2ad.translation: Atriwisp can declare the expected target in __ATRIX_CODE_0__, but the final target is decided by Atrinis.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:50c34e05.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is reserved as a plain text fallback;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:549c7c18.source: 禁用配置中的 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 表示禁用该平台所有投递。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:549c7c18.translation: Setting __ATRIX_CODE_0__ in the disable configuration means disabling all deliveries for this platform.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5987c868.source: Atriena v3 支持通过 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 字段发送图片和文件。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5987c868.translation: Atriena v3 supports sending images and files via the __ATRIX_CODE_0__ field.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5b41b059.source: 本文承接 [Atrinis 监听枢纽](atrinis.md)，讲如何启用 Atrinis、配置 Atriwisp 策略，并用 Atriena 投递事件。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5b41b059.translation: This article follows [Atrinis listening hub](atrinis.md) and explains how to enable Atrinis, configure Atriwisp policies, and use Atriena to deliver events.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5e9b28fa.source: 宿主在准备报告时导入附件，outbox 保存稳定媒体 ID，因此原 workspace 文件删除后仍可重试。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5e9b28fa.translation: The host imports attachments when preparing the report, and the outbox saves stable media IDs, so retries are still possible after the original workspace files are deleted.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5ec9d499.source: 后台 LLM 处理事件后，__ATRIX_CODE_0__ 的 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 可附带图片/文件。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:5ec9d499.translation: After the background LLM processes the event, the __ATRIX_CODE_1__ of __ATRIX_CODE_0__ can include images/files.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:67c632fe.source: direct/record 请求中 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 至少提供一个，LLM 模式仍必须提供 __ATRIX_CODE_3__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:67c632fe.translation: In direct/record requests, at least one of __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, or __ATRIX_CODE_2__ must be provided; LLM mode still requires __ATRIX_CODE_3__.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:75702380.source: 已有 HTTP(S) 来源仍兼容。

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:7995c248.source: Atriwisp 远端工具仅操作自己的文件，不获得宿主媒体导出路径、RPC 或存储凭据。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:7995c248.translation: Atriwisp remote tools only operate on their own files and do not obtain host media export paths, RPC, or storage credentials.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:809190ab.source: 该任务复用 sandbox 的清理时间表，但不按目录文件年龄删除 Media Center 内容。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:809190ab.translation: This task reuses the sandbox cleanup schedule but does not delete Media Center content based on the age of directory files.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:84933dd8.source: 发送期间和 outbox 待重试期间，媒体保留有效引用。成功发送的媒体会与对应平台消息关联，供后续引用回复使用；无法确定对应关系时不建立猜测关联。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:84933dd8.translation: During sending and while pending retry in the outbox, media retains valid references. Successfully sent media will be associated with the corresponding platform message for subsequent reference and replies; no speculative associations are created when the correspondence cannot be determined.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:8ffc9801.source: HTTP 响应只表示 Atrinis 已接收或拒绝请求，不等待 LLM 完成。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:8ffc9801.translation: The HTTP response only indicates that Atrinis has received or rejected the request, and does not wait for the LLM to complete.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:929743a7.source: 需要正式语义的字段应加入对应 Atriena 协议版本。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:929743a7.translation: Fields requiring formal semantics should be added to the corresponding Atriena protocol version.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:a0af80ab.source: 命中 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或单 Atriwisp __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 时才禁止。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:a0af80ab.translation: It is only prohibited when __ATRIX_CODE_0__ or a single Atriwisp __ATRIX_CODE_1__ is hit.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:abe0f9c9.source: 也可在 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 中填写 __ATRIX_CODE_1__ 引用中心资源。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:abe0f9c9.translation: You can also fill in __ATRIX_CODE_1__ in __ATRIX_CODE_0__ to reference central resources.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:b08b5848.source: 每个 HTTP 请求体必须且只能包含一个 JSON 值，尾随空白允许，尾随第二个 JSON 值或非法内容会返回 __ATRIX_CODE_0__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:b08b5848.translation: Each HTTP request body must contain exactly one JSON value. Trailing whitespace is allowed, but a trailing second JSON value or illegal content will return __ATRIX_CODE_0__.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:c7509ff3.source: 已发送缓存保留期复用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 的 __ATRIX_CODE_1__，非正值不保留发送后的缓存。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:c7509ff3.translation: The retention period for sent cache reuses __ATRIX_CODE_1__ of __ATRIX_CODE_0__; cache after sending is not retained if the value is not positive.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:d1120dc4.source: 宽限期起点保存在数据库，关闭 ATRI-X 的时间也计入，重启不重置；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:d1120dc4.translation: The start of the grace period is saved in the database; time spent with ATRI-X shut down is also counted, and restarting does not reset it;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:d5da1793.source: 所有引用消失后经过 1 小时孤儿宽限期，媒体维护任务才清理本体和记录；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:d5da1793.translation: After all references disappear and a 1-hour orphan grace period passes, the media maintenance task will clean up the entity and its records;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:d9671aec.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 为空时行为不变，非空时优先 segments 渲染，content 作为附加文本。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:d9671aec.translation: Behavior remains unchanged when __ATRIX_CODE_0__ is empty; when not empty, segments are rendered preferentially, and content serves as additional text.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:da82a931.source: Session、Transcript、fork 和待重试报告的独立引用仍保留。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:da82a931.translation: Independent references to Sessions, Transcripts, forks, and reports pending retry are still retained.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:e26628f9.source: 使用 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 时填写当前任务工作目录内的相对路径，不能使用绝对路径、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 或逃逸目录的 symlink/junction；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:e26628f9.translation: When using __ATRIX_CODE_0__, fill in the relative path within the current task working directory; absolute paths, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, __ATRIX_CODE_2__, or symlinks/junctions that escape the directory cannot be used;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:f79a2362.source: 启动 ATRI-X 后，可以用 curl 测试一个 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 事件：
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:f79a2362.translation: After starting ATRI-X, you can use curl to test a __ATRIX_CODE_0__ event:

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:f8d5e10f.source: 回复自己 Session 的最后一条 assistant 消息会自动恢复该 Session，回复更早的 assistant 消息会从该位置 Fork。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:f8d5e10f.translation: Replying to the last assistant message of your own Session will automatically restore that Session, while replying to an earlier assistant message will Fork from that position.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:fdaa0be9.source: 如果想让 ATRI-X 帮你生成 Atriwisp 监听器，可以在 work 模式下向超级管理员会话提出需求，例如：
docs/atrinis-usage.md:paragraph:fdaa0be9.translation: If you want ATRI-X to help you generate an Atriwisp listener, you can submit a request to the superadmin Session in work mode, for example:

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:05a363aa4f24.source: 具体事件源，例如服务名、脚本名、RSS 名。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:05a363aa4f24.translation: Specific event source, such as service name, script name, or RSS name.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:291d3860bd34.source: 必须在 Atrinis __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 裁决范围内，__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 会被忽略。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:291d3860bd34.translation: Must be within the Atrinis __ATRIX_CODE_0__ adjudication range; __ATRIX_CODE_1__ will be ignored.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:2fb33550734c.translation: Unique event ID within the source.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:35aea2af433e.source: 不会向外部 Atriwisp 返回媒体内容。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:35aea2af433e.translation: Media content will not be returned to external Atriwisp.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:35d701c0d643.source: LLM 模式必填，推荐使用 Atriyph Task Notation（任务表示法）__ATRIX_CODE_0__；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:35d701c0d643.translation: Required for LLM mode; it is recommended to use Atriyph Task Notation __ATRIX_CODE_0__;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:56ab1abb142f.source: 最终仍由 Atrinis 裁决。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:56ab1abb142f.translation: The final decision is still made by Atrinis.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:581a44bec011.source: Atrinis LLM 模型槽位，仅支持 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__；未填写或对应槽位未配置时回退到 __ATRIX_CODE_3__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:581a44bec011.translation: Atrinis LLM model slot, only supporting __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, and __ATRIX_CODE_2__; if left blank or the corresponding slot is not configured, it will fall back to __ATRIX_CODE_3__.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:6e096a14c248.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 透传平台原始 API，__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 使用统一能力名；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:6e096a14c248.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ passes through the platform's original API, while __ATRIX_CODE_1__ uses a unified capability name;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:7089fc7221c8.source: 普通工具注入 schema，Skill 注入任务说明并自动注入对应 runner；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:7089fc7221c8.translation: Ordinary tools inject the schema, while Skills inject task descriptions and automatically inject the corresponding runner;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:7160885468bf.source: direct/record 模式可为空，但 __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 至少提供一个。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:7160885468bf.translation: Can be empty in direct/record mode, but at least one of __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, or __ATRIX_CODE_2__ must be provided.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:79bb2ed09cd5.source: 文件名，用于下载保存和展示。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:79bb2ed09cd5.translation: File name, used for downloading, saving, and displaying.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:81222644427b.source: Atriwisp 名称，也是来源身份之一；仅允许英文字母、数字、__ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__，不允许点号。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:81222644427b.translation: Atriwisp name, which is also one of the source identities; only English letters, numbers, __ATRIX_CODE_0__, and __ATRIX_CODE_1__ are allowed; dots are not allowed.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:83a2d7711543.source: 外部事件发生时间；缺失时使用接收时间。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:83a2d7711543.translation: Occurrence time of the external event; the reception time is used if missing.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:852eac669104.source: 原始补充数据，只做记录和 prompt 附加。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:852eac669104.translation: Original supplementary data, used only for recording and prompt attachment.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:ad37db85afc7.source: Atriwisp 随事件声明的外部工具；默认允许，命中该 Atriwisp 的 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 时拒绝。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:ad37db85afc7.translation: External tools declared by Atriwisp with events; allowed by default, rejected when hitting the __ATRIX_CODE_0__ of that Atriwisp.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:b140f11c99fe.source: __ATRIX_CODE_0__、__ATRIX_CODE_1__、__ATRIX_CODE_2__ base64 URI，或已有媒体的完整 __ATRIX_CODE_3__。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:b140f11c99fe.translation: __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, __ATRIX_CODE_2__ base64 URI, or a complete __ATRIX_CODE_3__ of existing media.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:b84548fade94.translation: The first batch of capabilities includes __ATRIX_CODE_0__, __ATRIX_CODE_1__, and __ATRIX_CODE_2__.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:b9b16d252007.source: 事件标题，用于通知和后台 Session 标题。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:b9b16d252007.translation: Event title, used for notifications and background Session titles.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:c1f6f11d6b8c.source: direct 请求只有 __ATRIX_CODE_0__ 且没有 __ATRIX_CODE_1__/__ATRIX_CODE_2__ 时只执行 API，不发送消息。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:c1f6f11d6b8c.translation: When a direct request only has __ATRIX_CODE_0__ and lacks __ATRIX_CODE_1__/__ATRIX_CODE_2__, it only executes the API and does not send a message.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:c71f7bb7bb25.source: Atriwisp 期望投递目标数组，__ATRIX_CODE_0__ 表示发给平台超级管理员，__ATRIX_CODE_1__ 且带 __ATRIX_CODE_2__ 时发指定私聊/群聊，__ATRIX_CODE_3__ 表示所有已启用平台超级管理员。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:c71f7bb7bb25.translation: Atriwisp expects a delivery target array: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ indicates sending to the platform superadmin, __ATRIX_CODE_1__ with __ATRIX_CODE_2__ indicates sending to a specified private chat/group chat, and __ATRIX_CODE_3__ indicates all enabled platform superadmins.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:ce610112b781.source: Atriwisp 标签，用于日志和统计。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:ce610112b781.translation: Atriwisp tag, used for logs and statistics.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:e2b4484c39b4.source: 后台任务预加载的 ATRI-X 内部工具名或 Skill 名；
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:e2b4484c39b4.translation: The ATRI-X internal tool name or Skill name preloaded for background tasks;

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:e35fcc72efb3.source: LLM 后台 Session 模式：__ATRIX_CODE_0__ 或 __ATRIX_CODE_1__，默认 __ATRIX_CODE_2__；__ATRIX_CODE_3__ 不注入工具 schema，适合不需要工具的低成本后台处理。
docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:e35fcc72efb3.translation: LLM background Session mode: __ATRIX_CODE_0__ or __ATRIX_CODE_1__, default __ATRIX_CODE_2__; __ATRIX_CODE_3__ does not inject tool schema, suitable for low-cost background processing that does not require tools.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:e3b263ee01e2.translation: Plain text content, not persisted to disk.

docs/atrinis-usage.md:table:f12e2b41e623.source: Atriena v3 动作调用数组。
